_comment: Expected outcomes per scenario and app. These are TARGETS and hypotheses, not measurements: measured results live in Lab/results/ and Lab/COVERAGE.md. compare_results.py prints PASS, PARTIAL, FAIL or NOT TESTED against them. 'knownGap' marks a target the current release is known to miss.

stock.description: Stock, non-jailbroken device. Xcode, ad hoc or App Store install.
stock.regression: 1.3.0 reported jailbroken on iPhone18,1 / iOS 27.2.1 via dyldModified (fixed in 1.3.1). Any conclusive signal here is a release blocker.
stock.recorded: 2026-11-21, iPhone18,1, iOS 27.2.1. 1.3.0 false positive (dyldModified), fixed in 1.3.1. 1.3.x screenshots: JB Check Not jailbroken, Integrity Check Trusted 0. PASS.

xcode_debugger.description: Stock device, app launched from Xcode with the debugger attached (Debug build).

dopamine.description: Dopamine rootless jailbreak, no hiding tweak, app not excluded from injection.

dopamine_hidden.description: Dopamine plus a hiding tweak (e.g. roothide/Choicy/Shadow-style) enabled for the app.

trollstore.description: KaiselJBCheck installed via TrollStore (stock kernel, CoreTrust bypass).
trollstore.recorded: 2026-11-21, model and iOS not recorded, Kaisel 1.3.1: detected by both apps (reported by the owner; no JSON or screenshot in the repo).

frida_server.description: Jailbroken device, frida-server running, Frida attached to the running app with a hook script (authorised lab device).

frida_gadget.description: Stock device, KaiselIntegrityCheck repackaged with FridaGadget and re-signed.
frida_gadget.note: 1.4.0: FridaGadget is instrumentationImage (205), runtime risk, never conclusive jailbreak evidence. Before 1.4.0 it was reported as 200.

dopamine_roothide.description: Dopamine rootless with RootHide (randomised .jbroot-*), Sileo/Zebra installed, app NOT in RootHide's Blacklist.
dopamine_roothide.recorded: 2026-11-21, iPhone9,3, iOS 15.8.2. v1.2: JB Check PASS (roothideinit.dylib); full app device verdict elevated 56, fixed in 1.3. 1.3.x (screenshots, no JSON): JB Check Jailbroken (roothideinit.dylib from .jbroot-*, sileo://), Integrity Check device Compromised 85, runtime Compromised 97. PASS.

dopamine_roothide_hidden.description: Same device with the app enabled in RootHide's Blacklist (per-app hiding). Nothing is injected into the app.
dopamine_roothide_hidden.recorded: 2026-11-21, iPhone9,3, iOS 15.8.2. v1.2 FAIL (clean). One 1.3.1 run read Suspicious (not exported, not reproduced). 1.3.x screenshots: JB Check Not jailbroken, no indicators; Integrity Check Trusted 0. FAIL.
dopamine_roothide_hidden.knownGap: Missed in every recorded run: v1.2 and 1.3.x both apps clean (Not jailbroken, Trusted 0). The 1.3 residual signals (110, 111, 908) did not fire. Target kept so the miss stays visible.

dopamine_roothide_hidden_fresh.description: RootHide Blacklist on a fresh install that has never run unhidden: no Keychain marker and no server history. Measures what survives hiding with no memory.
dopamine_roothide_hidden_fresh.knownGap: Expected to be missed today: per-app hiding leaves no in-process evidence (see docs/LIMITATIONS.md).

dopamine_roothide_hidden_seen.description: RootHide Blacklist after a verified unhidden run of the same install (Keychain marker present, server history written for the App Attest key).
dopamine_roothide_hidden_seen.server: Reference server in strict mode should answer deny with 'jailbreak previously seen for this device key'.
dopamine_roothide_hidden_seen.note: The 1.3.x hidden screenshots showed no Reset jailbreak history button, so the marker was not seen there; re-test with exported JSON.

frida_spawn.description: Jailbroken device, the app spawned under Frida (authorised lab device).

frida_renamed.description: Authorised test build in which instrumentation file names and thread names differ from Frida's defaults. Measures which detectors do not depend on names.
frida_renamed.note: Name-based detectors (205, 500) are expected to miss; record which behaviour-based ones respond.

frida_late_attach.description: Instrumentation attached after the first assessment; run 'Evaluate now' again and keep IntegrityMonitor running.

shadow_class_hiding.description: Jailbroken device with a Shadow-class hiding tweak enabled for the app (hooks file and dyld APIs inside the process).

stock_ios26.description: Stock device on iOS 26 (false-positive baseline). Same expectation as 'stock'.
stock_ios26.recorded: 2026-11-21, model not recorded, Kaisel 1.3.1: clean (reported by the owner; no JSON or screenshot in the repo).
